LanguageData.RP_CustodyRules: A member who is released, paroled, transferred out, escapes or dies before their {0} days are up forfeits their bonus and nothing more. With fewer sessions than asked there is no bonus for them. Each is judged once. A shuttle called off, or filled by returning prisoners, adds a day to the arrival window (three at most). A member with no free bed of their level waits for one, and is dropped unpaid when the window ends. If the state steps in with special measures, the cohort not yet admitted is called off.
